ops.text: 31. INSURANCE. TrueLink shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000; and workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law. TrueLink shall provide Client with certificates of insurance on request.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added a short insurance provision after Force Majeure, as TrueLink hosts the Web Site and processes Client data but the Agreement requires no coverage; we dropped the one-year post-term coverage tail so the obligation runs only for the term. We can discuss reduced limits (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) if the higher limits are an issue.
proposal.summary: Insert Section 31 requiring TrueLink to carry CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M and statutory workers' compensation, with certificates on request.

mappings.element: Commercial general liability of USD 1M per occurrence.
Commercial general liability of USD 2M aggregate.
Professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2M.
Cyber and privacy insurance of USD 5M for vendors processing Customer Data.
Workers' compensation as required by law.
